newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac says Rabin peace efforts must continue.
newsitem.headline: Chirac says Rabin peace efforts must continue.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac sent a message on Thursday to Leah Rabin, widow of assassinated Israeli prime minister Yitzhak Rabin, saying his peace efforts must be continued a year after his death.

"Despite all the obstacles and violence, Yitzhak Rabin advanced the peace process step by step," Chirac said in a message marking the first anniversary of Rabin's killing by an Israeli extremist at a Tel Aviv peace rally on November 4.
"Today, a year after his brutal disappearance, all efforts must be made so that the dynamic process which he launched is not interrupted," Chirac wrote.
Chirac visited Israel and neighbouring Arab states last week and called for the creation of an independent Palestinian state, a position strongly opposed by the conservative Israeli government.
